newsitem.title: USA: Huntington Bancshares names vice chairmen.
newsitem.headline: Huntington Bancshares names vice chairmen.

text.p: Huntington Bancshares Inc said it has named Peter Geier and Ronald Seiffert as vice-chairman of the corporation.
In addition, Geier will be president and chief operating officer and Seiffert will be vice chairman of The Huntington National Bank, a unit of Huntington Bancshares Inc.
Geier previously served as executive vice president of Huntington's Consumer Services and Seiffert served in the same capacity for Commercial Services.
It said Frank Wobst will continue as chairman and chief executive of Huntington Bancshares Inc and Zuheir Sofia will remain its president, treasurer, and chief operating officer.
